Commissioning year added, owner and Chinese name corrected', 'https://www.nengyuanjie.net/article/98112.html', year=2024, owner='Shangdian Taonan New Energy Development Co Ltd (上电洮南新能源发展有限公司)', zhname='吉林洮南22.1MW分散式风电乡村振兴项目', note=True),

note_en: The Jilin Taonan 22.1 MW distributed rural revitalisation project, connected on 30 Aug 2024; not a phase of Datang’s Taonan wind farm
why: GEM's phase 2 cites nengyuanjie.net 98112, which describes the Jilin Taonan 22.1 MW distributed rural-revitalisation wind project invested by 上电洮南新能源发展有限公司, started 15 Mar 2024 and connected 30 Aug 2024. It is not a phase of Datang's 2006 Taonan wind farm (phase 1, 49 MW at a placeholder location); GEM's Datang owner/operator came from a dlzb tender page (502, unreadable). Owner set to the investor named in the quote (whether 上电 is Shanghai Electric or Shanghai Electric Power is not stated, so only the legal name is used); consider also renaming the record (e.g. 'Jilin Taonan Rural Revitalization Distributed wind farm').
